services.name: Sunset Cruise
services.desc: I booked a sunset cruise for my birthday and it was absolutely perfect! The yacht was spotless, luxurious, and had everything we needed to relax and celebrate. The views during sunset were breathtaking, and the captain and crew went above and beyond to make the evening feel special. Truly a one-of-a-kind experience.

blurb: Guests charter luxury yachts for private bespoke voyages tailored by captain and concierge based on weather, tides, and personal interests. The fleet includes meticulously maintained vessels exceeding international safety and luxury standards. Experiences include cruising, swimming, and enjoying Florida coastline views with professional crew and optional water toys.
